comment: Bambu Studio's own values for the settings the engine reads, applied last over OrcaSlicer 2.4.2's resolution of the Bambu Lab presets (filaments/BBL.json and resolved/bambu-lab.json) by packages/settings/scripts/apply-overlay.ts, which gen-resolved.ts also runs. Values are in the profiles' own format. filament: by preset name. machine and process: by printer model, nozzle size and quality tier, with the Bambu Studio preset each comes from. A per-variant list (Standard and High Flow values that differ) is never overlaid.
